os_list.name: Omarchy Quatro v1.0.6 - Arch Linux ARM (Pi 5 NVMe)
os_list.description: 100% like-for-like Omarchy v4 parity on Raspberry Pi 5. Features Hyprland 0.56.2 on Wayland with Aquamarine & Quickshell, Walker + Elephant launcher, Tokyo Night theme, 16k kernel, PCIe Gen 3 NVMe tuning, Argon active cooling, Flatpak layer (Obsidian, Pinta), Spotify webapp, and complete AI suite (omp, claude, codex, copilot, cursor, openclaw, herdr, voxtype, chatgpt, perplexity, vscode).

subitems.name: Omarchy Quatro v1.0.6 (Zstandard — Hyprland + Full AI Suite)
subitems.description: Boots straight to Hyprland 0.56.2 desktop with Walker launcher, Tokyo Night theme, btop, Chromium, and complete Omarchy v4 AI suite.
